<?php
/**
 * FluentAffiliate: two active affiliates and one waiting for approval, with visits from their links and referrals
 * on the shop's orders (some waiting for a payout, one being checked).
 */
use FluentAffiliate\App\Models\Referral;
use FluentAffiliate\App\Models\Visit;

$orders = (array) get_option('anypress_sample_orders', []);
foreach ($sample['affiliates'] as $a => [$who, $status, $referrals]) {
    $p = $sample['people'][$who];
    $userId = anypress_sample_user($p);
    if (!$userId) {
        continue;
    }
    [, $made] = anypress_sample_api('POST', '/fluent-affiliate/v2/affiliates', [
        'user_id' => $userId, 'status' => $status, 'rate_type' => 'default', 'payment_email' => anypress_sample_email($p),
        'note' => $status === 'pending' ? 'Applied from the affiliate page. Runs a style blog.' : '',
    ]);
    $affiliateId = (int) ($made['affiliate']['id'] ?? 0);
    if (!$affiliateId) {
        continue;
    }
    // Visits from the affiliate's link over the month.
    for ($v = 0; $v < 6 + $a * 4; $v++) {
        $visit = Visit::create([
            'affiliate_id' => $affiliateId,
            'url' => home_url('/?ref=' . $affiliateId),
            'referrer' => ['https://www.instagram.com/', 'https://www.pinterest.com/', 'https://www.google.com/'][$v % 3],
            'utm_campaign' => $v % 2 ? 'winter' : '',
            'ip' => '',
        ]);
        $visit->created_at = anypress_sample_when(28 - $v * 2.2, 12 + $v % 9);
        $visit->save();
    }
    foreach ($referrals as [$orderIndex, $refStatus]) {
        $order = isset($orders[$orderIndex]) ? \FluentCart\App\Models\Order::find($orders[$orderIndex]) : null;
        if (!$order) {
            continue;
        }
        [, $ref] = anypress_sample_api('POST', '/fluent-affiliate/v2/referrals', [
            'affiliate_id' => $affiliateId,
            'amount' => round($order->total_amount * 0.3 / 100, 2),
            'description' => 'Order #' . $order->id,
            'status' => $refStatus === 'paid' ? 'unpaid' : $refStatus,
            'type' => 'sale',
        ]);
        $referral = Referral::find((int) ($ref['referral']['id'] ?? 0));
        if ($referral) {
            // Tied to the order it came from, as FluentAffiliate's FluentCart integration does at checkout.
            $referral->provider = 'fluent_cart';
            $referral->provider_id = $order->id;
            $referral->order_total = $order->total_amount / 100;
            $referral->currency = $order->currency;
            $referral->created_at = $order->created_at;
            $referral->save();
        }
    }
}

/**
 * AutomatorWP: the business's own automations, switched on, and months of runs in its log. Each run is the event the
 * automation's trigger listens for (a post going live, a member joining a space, a signed-in customer buying or
 * booking), for the person it happened to, so its actions really ran (the CRM tag, the email), dated when it happened.
 */
$now = time();

/**
 * One automation as its editor saves it: the automation, one trigger and one action, each with its options. Runs once
 * per person when $perPerson is 1, every time when 0.
 */
$automation = static function (string $title, float $daysAgo, array $trigger, array $action, int $perPerson = 0): ?object {
    ct_setup_table('automatorwp_automations');
    $id = ct_insert_object([
        'title' => $title, 'type' => 'user', 'sequential' => 0, 'times_per_user' => $perPerson, 'times' => 0,
        'status' => 'active', 'date' => anypress_sample_when($daysAgo, 15),
    ]);
    ct_reset_setup_table();
    if (!$id) {
        return null;
    }
    $items = [];
    foreach (['trigger' => $trigger, 'action' => $action] as $kind => [$type, $options]) {
        ct_setup_table("automatorwp_{$kind}s");
        $item = ['automation_id' => $id, 'title' => '', 'type' => $type, 'status' => 'active', 'position' => 0, 'date' => anypress_sample_when($daysAgo, 15)];
        $item['id'] = ct_insert_object($item);
        // Its options may name the trigger's own tags ({trigger}:post_title), as the editor's tag picker writes them.
        foreach ($options as $key => $value) {
            ct_update_object_meta($item['id'], $key, str_replace('{trigger}', '{' . ($items['trigger']->id ?? 0), $value));
        }
        wp_cache_flush();
        ct_update_object(['id' => $item['id'], 'title' => automatorwp_parse_automation_item_edit_label((object) $item, $kind, 'view')]);
        ct_reset_setup_table();
        $items[$kind] = (object) $item;
    }
    wp_cache_flush();
    // AutomatorWP keeps each automation's triggers and actions for the request; these are new.
    AutomatorWP()->cache = [];
    return (object) ['id' => $id, 'trigger' => $items['trigger']];
};

/** The newest log id, so the logs one event writes can be dated after it. */
$newest = static function (): int {
    ct_setup_table('automatorwp_logs');
    $rows = (new CT_Query(['orderby' => 'id', 'order' => 'DESC', 'items_per_page' => 1]))->get_results();
    ct_reset_setup_table();
    return (int) ($rows[0]->id ?? 0);
};

/** One run: the trigger's own event for a person, its logs (and any email it sent) dated when it happened. */
$run = static function (array $event, string $when) use ($newest): void {
    $before = $newest();
    $GLOBALS['automatorwp_completed_triggers'] = [];
    automatorwp_trigger_event($event);
    ct_setup_table('automatorwp_logs');
    foreach ((new CT_Query(['orderby' => 'id', 'order' => 'DESC', 'items_per_page' => 10]))->get_results() as $log) {
        if ((int) $log->id > $before) {
            ct_update_object(['id' => $log->id, 'date' => $when]);
        }
    }
    ct_reset_setup_table();
    anypress_sample_mail_at($when);
};

/** A FluentCRM tag for an automation to add, made once. */
$tag = static function (string $title): int {
    return (int) \FluentCrm\App\Models\Tag::firstOrCreate(['slug' => sanitize_title($title)], ['title' => $title])->id;
};

$daysAgo = static fn (string $date) => ($now - strtotime($date . ' UTC')) / DAY_IN_SECONDS;
$oldest = static fn (array $dates) => $dates ? max(array_map($daysAgo, $dates)) + 3 : 120;

// Every site: the team hears when a post goes live, to share it.
$posts = get_posts(['post_type' => 'post', 'numberposts' => -1, 'orderby' => 'date', 'order' => 'ASC']);
$made = $automation(
    'Tell the team when a post goes live',
    $oldest(array_map(static fn ($p) => $p->post_date_gmt, $posts)),
    ['wordpress_publish_post', ['times' => 1]],
    ['wordpress_send_email', [
        'to' => get_option('admin_email'),
        'subject' => 'New on the blog: {trigger}:post_title}',
        'content' => "{trigger}:post_title} is live: {trigger}:post_url}\n\nShare it on social and add it to the next newsletter.",
    ]]
);
foreach ($made ? $posts : [] as $post) {
    $run(['trigger' => 'wordpress_publish_post', 'user_id' => (int) $post->post_author, 'post_id' => $post->ID], $post->post_date_gmt);
}

if (!defined('FLUENTCRM')) {
    return;
}

// Community: every new member is tagged in the CRM once, for the welcome emails.
if (defined('FLUENT_COMMUNITY_PLUGIN_VERSION')) {
    $joined = \FluentCommunity\App\Models\SpaceUserPivot::where('status', 'active')->where('role', 'member')->orderBy('created_at')->get();
    $made = $automation(
        'Tag new members in the CRM',
        $oldest($joined->pluck('created_at')->all()),
        ['fluentcommunity_join_space', ['space' => 'any', 'times' => 1]],
        ['fluentcrm_user_tag', ['tag' => $tag('Community member')]],
        1
    );
    foreach ($made ? $joined : [] as $member) {
        $run(['trigger' => 'fluentcommunity_join_space', 'user_id' => (int) $member->user_id, 'space_id' => (int) $member->space_id], (string) $member->created_at);
    }
}

// Shops: customers who buy while signed in are tagged as buyers.
if (defined('FLUENTCART_VERSION')) {
    $orders = \FluentCart\App\Models\Order::with(['customer', 'order_items'])->where('payment_status', 'paid')->orderBy('created_at')->get();
    $made = $automation(
        'Tag signed-in buyers',
        $oldest($orders->pluck('created_at')->all()),
        ['fluentcart_purchase_product', ['post' => 'any', 'times' => 1]],
        ['fluentcrm_user_tag', ['tag' => $tag('Bought online')]],
        1
    );
    foreach ($made ? $orders : [] as $order) {
        $user = $order->customer ? get_user_by('email', $order->customer->email) : null;
        foreach ($user ? $order->order_items : [] as $item) {
            $run(['trigger' => 'fluentcart_purchase_product', 'user_id' => $user->ID, 'post_id' => (int) $item->post_id, 'order_id' => $order->id], (string) $order->created_at);
        }
    }
}

// Bookings: clients who book while signed in are tagged, so the follow-up emails reach them.
if (defined('FLUENT_BOOKING_VERSION')) {
    $bookings = \FluentBooking\App\Models\Booking::orderBy('created_at')->get();
    $made = $automation(
        'Tag clients who book',
        $oldest($bookings->pluck('created_at')->all()),
        ['fluentbooking_schedule_meeting', ['post' => 'any', 'times' => 1]],
        ['fluentcrm_user_tag', ['tag' => $tag('Booked a session')]],
        1
    );
    foreach ($made ? $bookings : [] as $booking) {
        $user = get_user_by('email', $booking->email);
        if ($user) {
            $run(['trigger' => 'fluentbooking_schedule_meeting', 'user_id' => $user->ID, 'event_id' => (int) $booking->event_id, 'booking_id' => $booking->id], (string) $booking->created_at);
        }
    }
}

<?php
/**
 * FluentBooking: two hosts with their own calendars and weekly hours (lunch off, Saturday mornings, a day off next
 * week), the business's services, three months of sessions (done, a few no-shows and cancellations) and the next
 * two weeks filling up. With FluentCart on, paid services take payment through it, as on a real store: each has its
 * product, and every paid session has its order (paid, or refunded when it was cancelled).
 */
use FluentBooking\App\Models\Availability;
use FluentBooking\App\Models\Booking;
use FluentBooking\App\Services\BookingService;
use FluentBooking\App\Services\CalendarService;

$plan = $sample['bookings'];
$people = $sample['people'];
$week = static function (bool $saturday): array {
    $day = ['enabled' => true, 'slots' => [['start' => '09:00', 'end' => '12:30'], ['start' => '13:30', 'end' => '17:00']]];
    return [
        'sun' => ['enabled' => false, 'slots' => []],
        'mon' => $day, 'tue' => $day, 'wed' => $day, 'thu' => $day, 'fri' => $day,
        'sat' => $saturday ? ['enabled' => true, 'slots' => [['start' => '10:00', 'end' => '14:00']]] : ['enabled' => false, 'slots' => []],
    ];
};

$events = [];
foreach ($plan['hosts'] as $h => [$who, $bio]) {
    $userId = anypress_sample_user($people[$who]);
    if (!$userId) {
        continue;
    }
    wp_update_user(['ID' => $userId, 'description' => $bio, 'role' => 'editor']);
    $made = CalendarService::createCalendar([
        'title' => $people[$who][0] . ' ' . $people[$who][1],
        'description' => $bio,
        'user_id' => $userId,
    ]);
    $calendar = is_array($made) ? ($made['calendar'] ?? null) : null;
    if ($calendar) {
        // A host calendar takes its host's login as its title; the booking page shows the host's name instead.
        $calendar->title = $people[$who][0] . ' ' . $people[$who][1];
        $calendar->save();
    }
    $default = $calendar ? $calendar->events()->first() : null;
    if (!$default) {
        continue;
    }
    // Weekly hours: lunch off, Saturday mornings for the first host, and a day off next week.
    $hours = Availability::find($default->availability_id);
    if ($hours) {
        $value = $hours->value;
        $value['weekly_schedules'] = $week($h === 0);
        $value['date_overrides'] = [gmdate('Y-m-d', strtotime('+' . (8 + $h) . ' days')) => []];
        $hours->value = $value;
        $hours->key = $h === 0 ? 'Studio hours' : 'Coaching hours';
        $hours->save();
    }
    $mine = array_values(array_filter($plan['events'], static fn ($e) => $e[0] === $h));
    foreach ($mine as $n => [, $title, $minutes, $price, $where, $about]) {
        $location = ['phone' => 'phone_guest', 'in_person' => 'in_person_organizer', 'online' => 'online_meeting'][$where];
        $fields = [
            'title' => $title,
            'description' => $about . ($price ? ' $' . number_format($price / 100) . ', paid at the session.' : ' Free.'),
            'duration' => $minutes,
            'location_type' => $location,
            'location_settings' => [['type' => $location, 'title' => $where === 'in_person' ? '14 Willow Lane, Suite 2' : '', 'display_on_booking' => '']],
            'status' => 'active',
        ];
        if ($n === 0) {
            foreach ($fields as $key => $value) {
                $default->{$key} = $value;
            }
            $default->save();
            $slot = $default;
        } else {
            CalendarService::createCalendarEvents($calendar, [$fields + [
                'event_type' => 'single',
                'availability_type' => 'existing_schedule',
                'availability_id' => $default->availability_id,
            ]]);
            $slot = $calendar->events()->where('title', $title)->first();
        }
        foreach ($plan['events'] as $index => $event) {
            if ($event[1] === $title) {
                $events[$index] = $slot;
            }
        }
    }
}

$made = [];
$notes = ['Lower back has been tight since the move.', 'First time, a little nervous!', 'Would like to focus on pricing.', '', 'Running 5 minutes late is OK?', ''];
foreach ($plan['bookings'] as $n => [$event, $who, $daysAhead, $hour, $status]) {
    $slot = $events[$event] ?? null;
    if (!$slot) {
        continue;
    }
    $p = $people[$who];
    $start = strtotime('today ' . $hour . ':00 UTC') + $daysAhead * DAY_IN_SECONDS;
    // Weekends move to Monday, as the hours above allow.
    while (in_array(gmdate('w', $start), ['0', '6'], true)) {
        $start += DAY_IN_SECONDS;
    }
    try {
        $booking = BookingService::createBooking([
            'first_name' => $p[0],
            'last_name' => $p[1],
            'email' => anypress_sample_email($p),
            'phone' => '+1 555 01' . str_pad((string) (10 + $n), 2, '0', STR_PAD_LEFT),
            'message' => $notes[$n % count($notes)],
            'start_time' => gmdate('Y-m-d H:i:s', $start),
            'person_time_zone' => 'America/Los_Angeles',
            'status' => 'scheduled',
            'source' => 'web',
        ], $slot);
    } catch (\Throwable $e) {
        continue;
    }
    if (!$booking instanceof Booking) {
        continue;
    }
    // Booked a few days ahead, as clients do; the confirmation emails are dated then too.
    $booked = $start - (2 + $n % 6) * DAY_IN_SECONDS - 5 * HOUR_IN_SECONDS;
    // Sessions coming up soon were booked over the last week, not all today.
    if ($booked > time() - 900) {
        $booked = time() - (1 + $n % 7) * DAY_IN_SECONDS - (2 + $n % 9) * HOUR_IN_SECONDS;
    }
    $booked = gmdate('Y-m-d H:i:s', $booked);
    $booking->created_at = $booked;
    $booking->updated_at = $status === 'scheduled' ? $booked : gmdate('Y-m-d H:i:s', min(time() - 600, $start + 2 * HOUR_IN_SECONDS));
    $booking->status = $status;
    if ($status === 'cancelled') {
        $booking->internal_note = 'Cancelled by the client: travelling that week.';
    }
    if ($status === 'no_show') {
        $booking->internal_note = 'Did not arrive. Sent a friendly note to rebook.';
    }
    $booking->save();
    $made[] = [$booking, $slot, $who, $n, $status, $booked];
    // The confirmations FluentBooking's queue sends straight after a booking, sent now and dated when it was made.
    do_action('fluent_booking/after_booking_scheduled_async', $booking->id, $slot->id);
    as_unschedule_action('fluent_booking/after_booking_scheduled_async', [$booking->id, $slot->id], 'fluent-booking');
    anypress_sample_mail_at($booked);

// Paid services take payment through FluentCart, as on a real Bookings store: a product for each (made from the event's
// own Payment screen route), then an order for every paid session, paid when it was booked and refunded if cancelled.
if (defined('FLUENTCART_VERSION')) {
    require_once ANYPRESS_SAMPLE . '/cart.php';
    $products = [];
    foreach ($events as $index => $slot) {
        $price = (int) $plan['events'][$index][3];
        if (!$price || isset($products[$slot->id])) {
            continue;
        }
        [, $made_] = anypress_sample_api('POST', '/fluent-booking/v2/integrations/create/cart-product', ['title' => $slot->title, 'price' => $price / 100]);
        $variant = (int) ($made_['variant']['id'] ?? 0);
        if (!$variant) {
            continue;
        }
        wp_set_object_terms((int) $made_['variant']['post_id'], ['Sessions'], 'product-categories', false);
        anypress_sample_api('POST', "/fluent-booking/v2/calendars/{$slot->calendar_id}/events/{$slot->id}/cart-settings", [
            'settings' => ['enabled' => 'yes', 'multi_payment_enabled' => 'no', 'cart_product_id' => $variant],
        ]);
        $products[$slot->id] = \FluentCart\App\Models\ProductVariation::find($variant);
    }
    // Oldest first, so order numbers follow the dates.
    usort($made, static fn ($a, $b) => strcmp($a[5], $b[5]));
    foreach ($made as [$booking, $slot, $who, $n, $status, $booked]) {
        $variation = $products[$slot->id] ?? null;
        $customer = $variation ? anypress_sample_customer($people[$who], $n) : null;
        if (!$customer) {
            continue;
        }
        $order = anypress_sample_order($customer, [[$variation, 1]], (time() - strtotime($booked . ' UTC')) / DAY_IN_SECONDS, $status === 'cancelled' ? 'refunded' : 'paid');
        if (!$order) {
            continue;
        }
        // Linked both ways, as FluentBooking links them when the payment comes in: the booking shows its order.
        $config = (array) $order->config;
        $config['fcal_booking_id'] = $booking->id;
        $config['fcal_target_variant_id'] = $variation->id;
        $order->config = $config;
        $order->save();
        $booking->source_id = $order->id;
        $booking->payment_status = $status === 'cancelled' ? 'refunded' : 'paid';
        $booking->save();
    }
    anypress_sample_orders_done();
}

/**
 * One order placed from the admin screen's own path, then moved to what happened to it (pending, paid, shipped or
 * refunded) on the day it happened. Answers the order, or null.
 */
function anypress_sample_order(Customer $customer, array $lines, float $daysAgo, string $outcome): ?Order
{
    $items = [];
    foreach ($lines as [$variation, $quantity]) {
        $items[] = [
            'object_id' => $variation->id, 'post_id' => $variation->post_id, 'quantity' => $quantity,
            'unit_price' => $variation->item_price, 'title' => $variation->variation_title, 'post_title' => get_the_title($variation->post_id),
            'fulfillment_type' => $variation->fulfillment_type, 'other_info' => $variation->other_info,
            'payment_type' => $variation->payment_type ?: 'onetime',
        ];
    }
    $order = OrderResource::updatedPlaceOrder(['customer_id' => $customer->id, 'order_items' => $items]);
    if (!$order instanceof Order) {
        return null;
    }
    if ($outcome !== 'pending') {
        anypress_sample_api('POST', "/fluent-cart/v2/orders/{$order->id}/mark-as-paid", ['payment_method' => 'offline_payment']);
    }
    $ships = array_filter($items, static fn ($i) => $i['fulfillment_type'] === 'physical') !== [];
    if ($ships && in_array($outcome, ['shipped', 'paid', 'refunded'], true)) {
        anypress_sample_api('PUT', "/fluent-cart/v2/orders/{$order->id}/statuses", ['action' => 'change_shipping_status', 'statuses' => ['shipping_status' => 'shipped']]);
    }
    if ($outcome === 'paid') {
        anypress_sample_api('PUT', "/fluent-cart/v2/orders/{$order->id}/statuses", ['action' => 'change_order_status', 'statuses' => ['order_status' => 'completed']]);
        // Older orders arrived long ago (set on the order itself: the delivered email would only repeat the shipped one).
        $done = $ships ? Order::find($order->id) : null;
        if ($done) {
            $done->shipping_status = 'delivered';
            $done->save();
        }
    }
    if ($outcome === 'refunded') {
        $transaction = \FluentCart\App\Models\OrderTransaction::where('order_id', $order->id)->first();
        if ($transaction) {
            anypress_sample_api('POST', "/fluent-cart/v2/orders/{$order->id}/refund", ['refund_info' => ['transaction_id' => $transaction->id, 'amount' => $transaction->total, 'cancelSubscription' => false, 'manageStock' => true]]);
        }
    }
    // The order's own dates, so a month of sales shows on the reports.
    $when = anypress_sample_when($daysAgo, 11 + (int) $daysAgo % 8);
    foreach ([Order::class, \FluentCart\App\Models\OrderTransaction::class] as $model) {
        foreach ($model === Order::class ? [Order::find($order->id)] : $model::where('order_id', $order->id)->get() as $row) {
            if ($row) {
                $row->created_at = $when;
                $row->updated_at = $when;
                $row->save();
            }
        }
    }
    anypress_sample_mail_at($when);
    // The store's CRM lifecycle tags the buyer as checkout does (its hooks wait for a real payment).
    if ($outcome !== 'pending' && class_exists('AnyPress_CRM_Lifecycle')) {
        $paid = Order::find($order->id);
        foreach ($paid->subscriptions()->get() as $subscription) {
            AnyPress_CRM_Lifecycle::on_subscription_active(['subscription' => $subscription]);
        }
        AnyPress_CRM_Lifecycle::on_order_paid(['order' => $paid, 'customer' => $customer]);
        if ($outcome === 'refunded') {
            AnyPress_CRM_Lifecycle::on_full_refund(['order' => $paid, 'customer' => $customer]);
        }
    }
    $GLOBALS['anypress_sample_orders'][] = $order->id;
    return Order::find($order->id);
}

/** After the orders: each customer's totals counted again, and the owner's "new sale" emails left unsent. */
function anypress_sample_orders_done(): void
{
    // Each customer's order count, spend and first order, counted again now the orders carry their real dates.
    foreach (Customer::get() as $customer) {
        $customer->recountStat();
    }
    // Each subscription started with its order, and bills next on the same day of the month (or year) after today.
    foreach (\FluentCart\App\Models\Subscription::get() as $subscription) {
        $order = Order::find($subscription->parent_order_id);
        if (!$order) {
            continue;
        }
        $when = (string) $order->getRawOriginal('created_at');
        $next = strtotime($when . ' UTC');
        while ($next <= time()) {
            $next = strtotime($subscription->billing_interval === 'yearly' ? '+1 year' : '+1 month', $next);
        }
        $subscription->created_at = $when;
        $subscription->updated_at = $when;
        $subscription->next_billing_date = gmdate('Y-m-d H:i:s', $next);
        $subscription->save();
    }
    // FluentCart's follow-up for each paid order (the shop owner's "new sale" email) would all run on the first
    // visit, dated today; the demo's orders were paid months ago, so those stay unsent.
    as_unschedule_all_actions('fluent_cart/order_paid_async_private_handle', [], 'fluent-cart');
    $all = array_merge((array) get_option('anypress_sample_orders', []), $GLOBALS['anypress_sample_orders'] ?? []);
    update_option('anypress_sample_orders', array_values(array_unique($all)), false);
}

/** One of the plugin's own REST routes, as its admin screens call it. Answers [status, data]. */
function anypress_sample_api(string $method, string $route, array $params = []): array
{
    $request = new WP_REST_Request($method, $route);
    if ($method === 'GET') {
        $request->set_query_params($params);

        $request->set_header('content-type', 'application/json');

/**
 * Emails a step sent (logged by FluentSMTP's simulator) dated when that step happened, not when the demo was made.
 * Every email logged since the last call takes $when; with no $when, they keep the time they were sent.
 */
function anypress_sample_mail_at(?string $when = null): void
{
    // Kept between the demo's set-up steps, which are requests of their own.
    static $seen = null;
    $seen ??= (int) get_option('anypress_sample_mail_seen', 0);
    if (!class_exists('\\FluentMail\\App\\Models\\Logger')) {
        return;
    }
    $logger = new \FluentMail\App\Models\Logger();
    $newest = $seen;
    for ($page = 1; $page < 50; $page++) {
        $rows = $logger->get(['per_page' => 100, 'page' => $page]);
        $rows = $rows['data'] ?? (is_array($rows) ? $rows : []);
        $done = !$rows;
        foreach ($rows as $row) {
            $id = (int) ((array) $row)['id'];
            if ($id <= $seen) {
                $done = true;
                break;
            }
            $newest = max($newest, $id);
            if ($when !== null) {
                $logger->updateLog(['created_at' => $when, 'updated_at' => $when], ['id' => $id]);
            }
        }
        if ($done) {
            break;
        }
    }
    if ($newest !== $seen) {
        update_option('anypress_sample_mail_seen', $newest, false);
    }
    $seen = $newest;
}
